policy.standards: Metric meaning and improvement targets belong to a named standard. Preserve old standards when adding a new one so historical suites remain reproducible.
policy.suites: Each suite references one standard and owns regression thresholds anchored to an accepted result with the same suite fingerprint.
policy.thresholds: Future recommendations must meet every suite regression threshold. Raise thresholds when accepting stronger evidence; do not lower them merely to admit a regressing candidate.
policy.targets: Targets guide improvements across suite generations and are not release gates until adopted as regression thresholds.

criteria.description: Number of suite tasks that completed without an evaluation-harness error.
Fraction of tasks lost to provider, evaluator, timeout, decoding, or infrastructure errors rather than an incorrect answer.
Mean fraction of known relevant files named in each search answer.
Mean fraction of expected evidence cited with its path and either the expected line or text.
Total fixture files cited across search tasks that are not marked relevant.
Mean fraction of seeded defects reported at the exact expected path and line.
Mean fraction of seeded findings located at the exact expected path and line; currently equivalent to defect recall.
Mean fraction of seeded findings reported with the expected severity at the expected path.
Total review findings that do not match a seeded defect at its expected path and line.
Fraction of implementation tasks for which every check visible to the model passed.
Fraction of implementation tasks for which every withheld verification check passed.
Fraction of implementation tasks that changed only explicitly allowed paths.
Fraction of implementation tasks whose final structured review reported no actionable defect; tracked separately because reviewer precision is still improving.
Mean end-to-end duration per evaluation task.
Provider-estimated cost for the complete suite run.
